meta.title: Realized vs. Actual Budget Consumption: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan.
Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role and determine whether Realized vs. Actual Budget Consumption is refused or absent.
Repeat as a Finance Controller and determine whether the feature is available.
Compare both role outcomes and record any deliberate RBAC configuration.
